CASE STUDY
PROF. HEMANT SHETH, robotic surgeon.
A website that explains what he does in the terms patients search for, and a set of films that explain the operations themselves.

CLIENT
Consultant Upper GI, Laparoscopic & Hepatobiliary Surgeon, London and Hertfordshire
SCOPE
Website, 7 patient films, search and AI groundwork
SITE
22 pages
LIVE AT
londonroboticsurgeon.co.uk
londonroboticsurgeon.co.uk

WHAT WE BUILT
THREE PIECES THAT work together.
01
A site organised by operation
A treatment directory in four groups: upper GI, hepatobiliary, hernia and appendicectomy.
Ten individual procedure guides written for patients, from gallbladder surgery to complex incisional hernia.
A robotic surgery explainer with a comparison page for patients weighing up their options.
A profile page carrying his appointments and affiliations, and a page for each clinic location.
02
Built to be read by machines too
Structured data that tells search engines these are medical pages, who they are about and who published them.
An llms.txt file that gives AI assistants a plain summary of who he is and where to find each topic.
Crawl rules that welcome Google, Bing and the AI crawlers rather than blocking them.
An XML sitemap covering all 22 pages.
03
A film for the operations he explains most
7 films, 21 minutes in total, each two to three minutes long.
Scripts drafted from NHS, NICE and specialist guidance, in plain English and UK wording.
Anatomy animation combined with scenes of a consistent patient through symptom, consultation and recovery.
Delivered as 16:9 masters with narration and captions.

THE FILMS
7 OPERATIONS, EXPLAINED IN 21 minutes.
Watch any of them in full. Each has its own page with the transcript and sources.
